paragraphs.en: We introduce MixAgent, an agentic pipeline for music post-production that follows the workflow of audio engineers to build interpretable and editable mixing plans guided by a reference song. A grouping agent first routes related input tracks, such as drum recordings, into subgroups. A planning agent then uses retrieved examples to choose and order audio effects, such as volume control and reverb, for tracks, subgroups, and the full mix. To refine the mix, a detector identifies what needs correction, and a critic proposes numerical parameter adjustments from tracks to the full mix. In our experiments, prompting recent multimodal models to listen and revise often worsens the mix, making reliable correction a central challenge. We therefore build MixCritic, a dataset of 45,657 repair critiques derived from parameters fitted to professional mixes, and train the critic with supervised fine-tuning followed by preference optimization on rendered audio outcomes. On MedleyDB, learned refinement reduces error by 19% relative to the initial mix, with preference optimization reducing it by 8.4% over supervised training alone. Retrieved examples further improve effects selection, and a human listening test shows that MixAgent gets higher quality ratings than mixes produced by Qwen3-Omni, Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-4o-audio.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MixAgent，一个面向音乐后期制作的智能体流水线，它遵循音频工程师的工作流程，以参考歌曲为引导，构建可解释、可编辑的混音方案。 分组智能体首先将相关的输入音轨（如鼓的录音）路由到子组中。 随后，规划智能体利用检索到的示例，为音轨、子组和整体混音选择并排序音频效果，如音量控制和混响。 为进一步打磨混音，检测智能体识别需要修正之处，评判智能体则针对从单条音轨到整体混音提出数值化的参数调整。 在我们的实验中，提示近期的多模态模型去聆听并修改，往往会使混音效果变差，这使得可靠的修正成为一项核心挑战。 因此，我们构建了 MixCritic，一个包含 45,657 条修复型评论的数据集，这些评论源自针对专业混音拟合的参数；我们先用监督微调训练评判智能体，再在渲染出的音频结果上进行偏好优化。 在 MedleyDB 上，学习到的精修使误差相对初始混音降低了 19%，其中偏好优化在仅用监督训练的基础上再降低 8.4%。 检索到的示例进一步提升了效果选择的质量，人类听测表明，MixAgent 获得的质量评分高于 Qwen3-Omni、Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 GPT-4o-audio 生成的混音。

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents use tools to write code ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and edit images ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . In creative software, a key challenge is turning a high-level goal into precise settings. Noticing that “the vocal is too quiet” does not specify which control to move or by how much. Music mixing combines separately recorded instruments and vocals ( input tracks ) into a song by applying audio effects that control volume, frequency balance, and acoustic space. Related tracks can also be processed together as subgroups , such as all drum recordings, before processing the full mix . Settings interact, as louder drums can hide the vocal. Because the desired sound can be difficult to describe in words, we study reference-guided mixing , where a reference song provides an example.

paragraphs.en: Existing systems address parts of this problem (Figure 1 ). Neural and generative models produce competitive audio without exposing audio effects settings ( Koo et al., 2023 ; Moliner et al., 2026 ) , while Diff-MST predicts editable parameters for fixed sequences of audio effects ( Vanka et al., 2024 ) . Prior LLM-based systems address narrower tasks. LLM2Fx-Tools predicts audio effects chains for individual tracks ( Doh et al., 2026 ) , and RIME edits an existing mix to follow instructions ( Schaffer and Singh, 2026 ) . Building a mix from tracks requires choosing and ordering effects at the track, subgroup, and full-mix levels, setting their parameters, and identifying corrections without editing instructions. Simply prompting an audio-language model to listen and revise does not consistently improve the mix.
paragraphs.zh: 现有系统只解决了这一问题的一部分（图 1）。 神经模型与生成式模型可以生成具有竞争力的音频，但不暴露音频效果器设置（Koo et al., 2023；Moliner et al., 2026），而 Diff-MST 则为固定的音频效果器序列预测可编辑的参数（Vanka et al., 2024）。 先前基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统所处理的任务范围较窄。 LLM2Fx-Tools 为单条音轨预测音频效果器链（Doh et al., 2026），RIME 则根据指令对现有混音进行编辑（Schaffer and Singh, 2026）。 从音轨构建混音需要在音轨、子组和整轨混音三个层级上选择并排序效果器、设置其参数，并在没有编辑指令的情况下找出需要修正之处。 仅仅提示一个音频-语言模型去聆听并修改，并不能持续地改善混音效果。

paragraphs.en: MixAgent builds an editable mixing plan and refines its parameters. A grouping agent organizes related tracks into subgroups. Guided by retrieved examples, a frozen planner chooses and orders audio effects at all three levels, then initializes their parameters. A learned detector selects what needs correction , and a critic proposes how to fix it . Refinement makes one pass at each level, from tracks to subgroups to the full mix, so later stages hear earlier corrections. Because no known corpus pairs mixing critiques with parameter repairs, we build MixCritic, containing 45,657 critiques. We train the critic with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then direct preference optimization (DPO), favoring corrections toward the audio produced by the fitted parameters. Every effect, parameter, and correction remains explicit and editable.
paragraphs.zh: MixAgent 构建一个可编辑的混音计划并细化其参数。 一个分组智能体将相关音轨组织成子组。 在检索到的示例的引导下，一个冻结的规划器在所有三个层级上选择音频效果并对其排序，然后初始化它们的参数。 一个学习得到的检测器选出需要修正的内容，而一个评论智能体提出如何修复它。 细化过程在每个层级各进行一遍，从音轨到子组再到整个混音，这样后续阶段能听到先前阶段的修正效果。 由于没有已知语料库将混音评论与参数修复配对，我们构建了 MixCritic，其中包含 45,657 条评论。 我们先通过监督微调（SFT）训练评论智能体，再通过直接偏好优化（DPO）进行训练，偏向于朝向由拟合参数生成的音频的修正。 每个效果、参数和修正都保持显式且可编辑。

paragraphs.en: The design also raises a broader question. What makes feedback useful for agents acting through numerical tools? Our analyses show that retrieved examples improve audio effects selection, while learned refinement improves their parameters. This refinement benefits from more specific feedback, with numerical corrections giving lower reconstruction error than perceptual or tool-specific advice. With numerical feedback, DPO reduces this error by a further 8.4% over SFT. Beyond feedback, selecting correction targets and refining tracks before subgroups and the full mix further reduces error.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计还引出了一个更广泛的问题。 对于通过数值工具进行操作的智能体而言，什么样的反馈才是有用的？ 我们的分析表明，检索到的示例可以改进音效选择，而学习到的细化则可以改进其参数。 这种细化受益于更具体的反馈，数值修正比感知性建议或工具特定建议带来更低的重构误差。 在数值反馈下，DPO 相比 SFT 将该误差进一步降低了 8.4%。 除反馈之外，选择修正目标，并在子混音和整体混音之前对音轨进行细化，也能进一步降低误差。

paragraphs.en: We construct MixCritic, providing repair critiques in three feedback forms and preference pairs ranked by the resulting audio.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 MixCritic，以三种反馈形式提供修复意见，并生成按所得音频排序的偏好对。

paragraphs.en: We show complementary reconstruction gains from retrieval and learned numerical refinement, with further improvements from selecting correction targets and refining tracks before subgroups and the full mix.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了检索与学习式数值细化的互补重建增益，并且通过选择校正目标以及在细分子组与完整混合之前对轨迹进行细化，可以获得进一步的改进。

paragraphs.en: The input consists of individual audio recordings, called input tracks , such as a lead vocal, a bass guitar, or a single drum microphone. Mixing proceeds at three levels: individual tracks, subgroups of related tracks summed and processed together (e.g., all drum tracks), and the full mix formed by summing all subgroup outputs. Subgroup and full-mix processing correspond to subgroup buses and the master bus, respectively. The output after all processing is the final mix . Mixing engineers shape the audio at each level with audio effects , signal-processing tools controlled by numerical parameters. Typical audio effects include gain (volume), panning (left–right position), equalization (EQ, the balance of low and high frequencies), compression (reducing loudness fluctuations), and reverb (a sense of acoustic space). An ordered list of audio effects, such as EQ followed by compression, is an audio effects chain .
paragraphs.zh: 输入由单独的音频录音组成，称为输入轨，例如主唱人声、贝斯吉他或单个鼓组麦克风。 混音在三个层次上进行：单独的音轨、将相关音轨求和并一起处理的子组（例如所有鼓组音轨），以及由所有子组输出求和形成的完整混音。 子组处理和完整混音处理分别对应子组总线和主总线。 所有处理之后的输出就是最终混音。 混音工程师在每个层次上使用音频效果器来塑造声音，音频效果器是由数值参数控制的信号处理工具。 常见的音频效果器包括增益（音量）、声像（左右位置）、均衡（EQ，即低频与高频的平衡）、压缩（减少响度波动）以及混响（一种声学空间感）。 按顺序排列的音频效果器列表，例如先均衡后压缩，称为音频效果链。

sents.en: Mixing proceeds at three levels: individual tracks, subgroups of related tracks summed and processed together (e.g., all drum tracks), and the full mix formed by summing all subgroup outputs.

sents.en: Subgroup and full-mix processing correspond to subgroup buses and the master bus, respectively.
sents.zh: 子组处理和完整混音处理分别对应子组总线和主总线。

sents.en: The output after all processing is the final mix .
sents.zh: 所有处理之后的输出就是最终混音。

sents.en: Mixing engineers shape the audio at each level with audio effects , signal-processing tools controlled by numerical parameters.
sents.zh: 混音工程师在每个层次上使用音频效果器来塑造声音，音频效果器是由数值参数控制的信号处理工具。

sents.en: Typical audio effects include gain (volume), panning (left–right position), equalization (EQ, the balance of low and high frequencies), compression (reducing loudness fluctuations), and reverb (a sense of acoustic space).
sents.zh: 常见的音频效果器包括增益（音量）、声像（左右位置）、均衡（EQ，即低频与高频的平衡）、压缩（减少响度波动）以及混响（一种声学空间感）。

sents.en: An ordered list of audio effects, such as EQ followed by compression, is an audio effects chain .
sents.zh: 按顺序排列的音频效果器列表，例如先均衡后压缩，称为音频效果链。

paragraphs.en: The agent must infer audio effects chains and settings to match the reference’s mixing style rather than copy audio, since instrumentation, arrangement, or genre may differ. It must also account for interactions across tracks, subgroups, and the full mix. Our datasets lack ground-truth mixes with references from other songs. We therefore use two non-overlapping excerpts of the same song for training and main evaluation (§ 4.1 ). The listening test uses references from other songs within the same genre (§ 4.3 ). MixAgent keeps every audio effect and setting explicit, so users can inspect the plan, change values, and render the mix again. Audio is produced only by applying these audio effects to the input tracks, avoiding hallucinated musical content and artifacts from direct neural audio generation.

paragraphs.en: A grouping agent first listens to the input tracks, reads their instrument labels, and assigns each track to a subgroup (e.g., kick, snare, and cymbals form a drum subgroup). A frozen audio-language tool-planning agent then selects audio effects chains. Without examples, the planner tends to select short chains (§ 5.2 ). To guide its choices, we use GRAFX ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , a differentiable audio-processing library, to estimate example plans. GRAFX fits audio effect parameters to approximate each database song’s professional mix, then removes effects that barely change the rendered audio ( Lee et al., 2025b ) . Each database entry stores these pseudo-ground-truth (pseudo-GT) plans and a caption of the rendered mix. For a new song, text retrieval matches automatically generated input-track captions to database captions to find similar instrumentation. Audio retrieval matches the reference to rendered database mixes for similar mixing styles. We provide three text-retrieved and one audio-retrieved plan, excluding all excerpts of the input song. These examples show effect choices and order, but not parameter values. The planner selects track, subgroup, and full-mix chains in order, with each level guided by earlier choices. The chains remain fixed. Appendix B.1 and F provide details and prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 一个分组智能体首先聆听输入音轨，读取其乐器标签，并将每条音轨分配到一个子组（例如，底鼓、军鼓和镲片组成一个鼓子组）。 然后由一个冻结的音频-语言工具规划智能体选择音频效果器链。 在没有示例的情况下，规划器倾向于选择较短的链（§ 5.2）。 为引导其选择，我们使用 GRAFX（Lee et al., 2024），这是一个可微分的音频处理库，用于估计示例规划。 GRAFX 通过拟合音频效果器参数来逼近数据库中每首歌曲的专业混音，然后移除几乎不改变渲染音频的效果器（Lee et al., 2025b）。 每条数据库条目存储这些伪真值（pseudo-GT）规划以及渲染混音的描述。 对于一首新歌，文本检索将自动生成的输入音轨描述与数据库描述进行匹配，以找到相似的乐器配置。 音频检索将参考音频与渲染后的数据库混音进行匹配，以找到相似的混音风格。 我们提供三个通过文本检索和一个通过音频检索的规划，并排除输入歌曲的所有片段。 这些示例展示了效果器的选择与顺序，但不包含参数值。 规划器依次选择音轨、子组和整轨混音链，每一层级都由之前的选择引导。这些链保持固定。 附录 B.1 和 F 提供了详细信息和提示词。

paragraphs.en: We build the task from MedleyDB ( Bittner et al., 2014 ) , using its unprocessed recordings as unprocessed input tracks and its professional mixes as targets. Our datasets lack ground-truth mixes made to match references from other songs. We therefore sample two non-overlapping 15-second windows from each song section: one provides the unprocessed input tracks and the ground-truth mix (GT), for supervision and evaluation, and the other provides the style reference. This preserves a similar mixing style without providing the target audio as the reference. At evaluation, GT is used only for scoring. This gives 185 clips from 123 songs (Appendix A.1 ). We hold out 20 clips for evaluation, with artists disjoint from training. For cross-corpus transfer, we build AlbumDB clips ( McKenzie et al., 2026 ) identically.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate reconstruction, audio quality, and mixing-style similarity. Multi-Scale Spectral (MSS) ( Engel et al., 2020 ) compares the frequency content of the output and GT over time at several resolutions, using the sum and difference of the left and right channels. Multi-Resolution STFT (MRS) ( Yamamoto et al., 2020 ) , used in training and analyses, makes this comparison for each channel. TuneJury ( Kim et al., 2026 ) predicts listener preference, and Audiobox ( Tjandra et al., 2025 ) predicts production quality (AAPQ). Neither uses GT or the style reference. For similarity to GT, FxEnc++ ( Yeh et al., 2025 ) compares learned audio effects representations, while Audio Feature loss (AF) ( Vanka et al., 2024 ) compares hand-crafted features of volume, loudness fluctuations, frequency balance, and left–right spread. We omit RLAT similarity because we train on its representations.

paragraphs.en: We conducted a multi-stimulus listening test to evaluate perceptual music production quality in a practical reference-based mixing scenario. Input tracks were paired with a reference mix from a different song within the same genre. Eleven participants completed 10 trials each, evaluating the production quality of mixes by MixAgent, three LLM baselines, a randomly processed anchor, and the original human mix on a 0–100 scale. Figure 4 shows that three LLM baselines exhibit largely overlapping score distributions, with no statistically significant differences among them. In contrast, MixAgent achieves significantly higher scores than all three baselines ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , Holm-corrected paired t-tests), while a substantial perceptual gap remains relative to the original human mixes.

paragraphs.en: Retrieval and learned refinement are complementary. We run the hierarchical planner with and without retrieved examples, each with and without learned refinement (Table 5 ). Retrieval lowers MRS by 0.64, both without refinement (2.81 to 2.17) and with it (2.39 to 1.75), and refinement lowers MRS by 0.42 in either case. MSS likewise improves by 0.82 from retrieval and 0.87 from refinement. Retrieval improves the choice of audio effects, and refinement improves their parameters, with additive gains. We compare MixAgent’s bottom-up order with a top-down order (full mix, then subgroups, then tracks) and with a variant where corrections are computed from the initial audio and applied at once. Bottom-up refinement gives the lowest MRS (1.75, vs. 1.82 and 1.88) and MSS (Table 5 ), suggesting that later corrections benefit from hearing earlier ones. With the critic fixed, detector selection yields lower MRS (1.75) than inspecting all tracks and subgroups (1.87) or an equally sized random subset (1.81), and the lowest MSS. Selecting appropriate targets matters more than inspecting additional elements. Appendix D.4 reports detector accuracy.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents call tools ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) and refine their outputs with self-generated feedback ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , but self-correction without an external signal often fails ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , which motivates trained correctors ( Welleck et al., 2023 ) . In music production, LLM2Fx predicts audio effects parameters from text ( Doh et al., 2025 ) , LLM2Fx-Tools recovers the audio effect chain of a single track through tool calls ( Doh et al., 2026 ) , and MixAssist gives mixing advice in conversation ( Clemens and Marasović, 2025 ) . RIME listens between tool calls and edit finished mixes from synthetic instruction–edit pairs ( Schaffer and Singh, 2026 ) . MixAgent instead builds mixes from unprocessed input tracks, and its detector and critic are trained on whether each correction improves the rendered audio.

paragraphs.en: Explicit-processing methods estimate differentiable audio-effect parameters ( Steinmetz et al., 2021 ; Steinmetz et al., 2022 ; Vanka et al., 2024 ; Steinmetz et al., 2024 ; Koo et al., 2025 ) or variable-length chains ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , but most use fixed consoles without selecting effects or grouping tracks. GRAFX fits graphs to known targets ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025b ) , supplying our retrieval plans, training data, and oracles. Neural approaches include end-to-end mixing ( Martínez-Ramírez et al., 2022 ) , style transfer ( Koo et al., 2023 ) , and diffusion or flow-based generation ( Levy et al., 2023 ; Melechovsky et al., 2026 ; Moliner et al., 2026 ; Yeh et al., 2026 ) . Diff2Mix instead decodes generated embeddings into fixed-console parameters ( Zong et al., 2026 ) . Direct audio generation can introduce artifacts and obscure audio effect settings ( Melechovsky et al., 2026 ; Moliner et al., 2026 ) . MixAgent combines open-ended chains, subgroups, and editable parameters with detection and correction learned from rendered audio.

paragraphs.en: We presented MixAgent, an audio-language agent that mixes music by building an explicit plan of audio effects over tracks, subgroups, and the full mix, then refines it bottom-up with a learned detector and critic. Our results suggest a broader lesson for agents that act through numerical tools. Targeted, executable feedback trained on outcomes improves mixing. Because each decision logs a named audio effect and value, users can inspect the result, trace corrections, and edit the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MixAgent，这是一个音频-语言智能体，它通过为音轨、子编组和整条混音构建显式的音频效果计划来进行混音，然后利用学习到的检测器和评审器自底向上地对计划进行细化。 我们的结果为通过数值工具执行操作的智能体提供了一个更广泛的启示。 基于结果训练的、有针对性的可执行反馈能够改进混音。 由于每个决策都会记录一个具名的音频效果及其数值，用户可以查看结果、追溯修正过程并编辑该计划。

paragraphs.en: First, multiple mixes can be valid for the same input tracks, so reconstruction error against one professional mix does not fully capture mixing quality ( Moliner et al., 2026 ) . In our experiments, TuneJury is useful mainly for detecting severe degradation and is not yet sufficient as a standalone objective metric for assessing mixing quality. TuneJury ( Kim et al., 2026 ) operates on mono audio (48 kHz for CLAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ) and 24 kHz for MERT ( Li et al., 2024 ) ), while Audiobox Aesthetics uses 16 kHz mono audio. These representations limit direct assessment of stereo imaging and, for Audiobox, high-frequency detail. Developing reliable perceptual metrics for multitrack mixing remains a separate research challenge beyond the scope of this work. Second, the evaluation sets are small (20 MedleyDB clips from 17 songs, 14 AlbumDB clips, and 10 clips for the listening study), limiting generalizability and the precision of perceptual comparisons. Results on AlbumDB are mixed. MST accepts only four sources, so we ran it on the separated professional mix rather than on identical input tracks, limiting direct comparability. Third, supervision and oracles come from GRAFX-fitted parameters, which approximate, but do not recover, the engineer’s settings. The large gap to GT-fitted parameters (1.75 vs. 0.90 MRS) shows that parameter setting remains far from solved. Fourth, our audio effects library covers only a small subset of the processing tools available to professional audio engineers, creating a tool gap that limits the range of achievable mixes. The plan is also fixed after planning, so the critic cannot add or remove audio effects. Finally, although explicit plans expose editable audio effects and parameters, we have not evaluated how users interpret or modify them in practice. Producing a mix also requires many calls to large audio-language models, limiting computational efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，对于相同的输入音轨，可能存在多种有效的混音结果，因此与某一个专业混音对比的重构误差并不能完整反映混音质量（Moliner et al., 2026）。 在我们的实验中，TuneJury 主要用于检测严重的质量退化，尚不足以作为评估混音质量的独立客观指标。 TuneJury（Kim et al., 2026）处理的是单声道音频（CLAP（Wu et al., 2023）为 48 kHz，MERT（Li et al., 2024）为 24 kHz），而 Audiobox Aesthetics 使用 16 kHz 的单声道音频。 这些表示方式限制了对立体声声像的直接评估，也限制了 Audiobox 对高频细节的评估。 为多轨混音开发可靠的感知指标仍是一个独立的研究难题，超出了本工作的范围。 其次，评估集规模较小（来自 17 首歌曲的 20 个 MedleyDB 片段、14 个 AlbumDB 片段以及用于听音实验的 10 个片段），这限制了结论的泛化能力和感知比较的精度。 AlbumDB 上的结果好坏参半。 MST 只接受四个音源，因此我们在分离出的专业混音上运行它，而不是在相同的输入音轨上运行，这限制了直接可比性。 第三，监督信号和 oracle 均来自 GRAFX 拟合的参数，这些参数是对工程师设置值的近似，而非完全还原。 与 GT 拟合参数之间的大差距（1.75 对 0.90 MRS）表明，参数设置问题仍远未解决。 第四，我们的音频效果库仅覆盖专业音频工程师可用处理工具中的一小部分，形成了工具差距，限制了可实现混音的范围。 此外，规划完成后方案即被固定，因此评审模块无法增删音频效果。 最后，尽管显式方案暴露了可编辑的音频效果和参数，我们尚未评估用户在实践中如何解读或修改它们。 生成一次混音还需要多次调用大型音频-语言模型，这限制了计算效率。

paragraphs.en: We run a music-structure analysis on each MedleyDB song and, in every section longer than 35 s, sample one pair of non-overlapping 15-s windows at least 5 s apart (§ 4.1 ). paragraphs.en: Section 3.3 and Figure 3 describe how MixCritic is built, and Table 8 summarizes it. paragraphs.en: Dedicated mixing models are trained for reference-guided mixing but differ from our setting in their inputs or output space, so we report them separately (Table 9 ). Diff-MST ( Vanka et al., 2024 ) takes the unprocessed input tracks and predicts the parameters of a fixed differentiable console, with gain, EQ, compression, and panning on each track and EQ and compression on the full mix. It cannot choose audio effects or group tracks. Diff-MST is trained on MedleyDB and Cambridge-MT, so its training songs may overlap our MedleyDB evaluation clips, and the comparison is not strictly fair. MST ( Koo et al., 2023 ) is an end-to-end network that outputs processed audio and exposes no audio effects parameters. It is trained on four instrument classes (vocals, drums, bass, and other), and for mixture inputs its authors first apply source separation. Following this setup, we separate the professional mix into the four sources with Demucs ( Défossez, 2021 , mdx_extra ;) , and MST restyles each of them to match the reference. StemFX ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) predicts variable-length audio effects chains on source-separated tracks and is applied in the same way. MST and StemFX therefore start from the professionally mixed version of the target, which gives them privileged access to GT.
paragraphs.zh: 专用的混音模型是为参考引导混音训练的，但其输入或输出空间与我们的设置不同，因此我们单独报告它们（表 9）。 Diff-MST（Vanka 等人，2024）接收未经处理的输入音轨，并预测一个固定可微分调音台的参数，包括每条音轨的增益、均衡、压缩和声像，以及整条混音的均衡和压缩。 它无法选择音频效果器，也无法对音轨进行分组。 Diff-MST 在 MedleyDB 和 Cambridge-MT 上训练，因此其训练歌曲可能与我们的 MedleyDB 评估片段重叠，该比较并不完全公平。 MST（Koo 等人，2023）是一种端到端网络，输出处理后的音频，且不暴露音频效果器参数。 它在四个乐器类别（人声、鼓、贝斯和其他）上训练，对于混合输入，其作者首先进行音源分离。 按照这一设置，我们使用 Demucs（Défossez，2021，mdx_extra;）将专业混音分离为四个音源，然后由 MST 对每个音源进行重新风格化以匹配参考。 StemFX（Cheng 等人，2026）在音源分离后的音轨上预测可变长度的音频效果器链，并以相同的方式应用。 因此，MST 和 StemFX 都是从目标的 professionally 混音版本出发，这使它们获得了对真实值（GT）的特权访问。

paragraphs.en: MixAgent builds its plan the way an engineer would. Its grouping agent listens to the tracks and reads their labels before assigning subgroups, and its planner chooses the audio effects and their order for each track, subgroup, and the full mix. GRAFX, which builds the pseudo-GT plans used for retrieval and audio effects chain F1 (§ 3.1 ), instead starts from a fixed console that applies every audio effect in the same order everywhere. It fits all parameters to the professional mix and prunes processors that barely affect the result ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025b ) . Figures 5 – 8 compare the final plans of MixAgent with GRAFX plans for two MedleyDB and two AlbumDB clips.
paragraphs.zh: MixAgent 以工程师的方式来构建它的计划。 它的分组智能体会先聆听各条音轨并读取其标签，再分配子组；它的规划器则为每条音轨、每个子组以及整个混音选择音频效果及其顺序。 GRAFX（它构建用于检索和音频效果链 F1 的伪真值计划，见 § 3.1）则是从一个固定的调音台出发，该调音台在各处都以相同的顺序应用每一种音频效果。 它将所有参数拟合到专业混音上，并剪除那些对结果几乎没有影响的处理器（Lee et al., 2024；Lee et al., 2025b）。 图 5–8 比较了 MixAgent 与 GRAFX 在两段 MedleyDB 和两段 AlbumDB 片段上的最终计划。

sents.en: MixAgent builds its plan the way an engineer would.
sents.zh: MixAgent 以工程师的方式来构建它的计划。

sents.zh: 它的分组智能体会先聆听各条音轨并读取其标签，再分配子组；它的规划器则为每条音轨、每个子组以及整个混音选择音频效果及其顺序。

sents.en: GRAFX, which builds the pseudo-GT plans used for retrieval and audio effects chain F1 (§ 3.1 ), instead starts from a fixed console that applies every audio effect in the same order everywhere.
sents.zh: GRAFX（它构建用于检索和音频效果链 F1 的伪真值计划，见 § 3.1）则是从一个固定的调音台出发，该调音台在各处都以相同的顺序应用每一种音频效果。

sents.en: It fits all parameters to the professional mix and prunes processors that barely affect the result ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025b ) .
sents.zh: 它将所有参数拟合到专业混音上，并剪除那些对结果几乎没有影响的处理器（Lee et al., 2024；Lee et al., 2025b）。

sents.en: Figures 5 – 8 compare the final plans of MixAgent with GRAFX plans for two MedleyDB and two AlbumDB clips.
sents.zh: 图 5–8 比较了 MixAgent 与 GRAFX 在两段 MedleyDB 和两段 AlbumDB 片段上的最终计划。

paragraphs.en: MixAgent forms subgroups that follow the instrumentation. In Figure 7 , it creates drum, bass, guitar, and vocal subgroups, whereas GRAFX uses no subgroups and sends all eight tracks to the full mix. In Figure 8 , it places the violins, cello, and viola in one subgroup together with the bass, whereas GRAFX groups only the two violins and splits the rest of the string section. In Figures 5 and 6 , both plans use the same subgroups.
paragraphs.zh: MixAgent 生成遵循插线（instrumentation）安排的子组。 在图 7 中，它创建了鼓、贝斯、吉他和人声子组，而 GRAFX 不使用任何子组，将全部八条音轨直接发送到整体混音。 在图 8 中，它将小提琴、大提琴和中提琴与贝斯一起放入同一个子组，而 GRAFX 仅将两把小提琴编为一组，并把弦乐组的其余部分分开。 在图 5 和图 6 中，两种方案使用相同的子组。

sents.en: MixAgent forms subgroups that follow the instrumentation.
sents.zh: MixAgent 生成遵循插线（instrumentation）安排的子组。

sents.en: In Figure 7 , it creates drum, bass, guitar, and vocal subgroups, whereas GRAFX uses no subgroups and sends all eight tracks to the full mix.
sents.zh: 在图 7 中，它创建了鼓、贝斯、吉他和人声子组，而 GRAFX 不使用任何子组，将全部八条音轨直接发送到整体混音。

sents.en: In Figure 8 , it places the violins, cello, and viola in one subgroup together with the bass, whereas GRAFX groups only the two violins and splits the rest of the string section.

paragraphs.en: MixAgent chooses the order for each element. It places the noise gate before the compressor on the drums (Figure 5 ) and on the vocals (Figures 7 and 8 ), as engineers usually do, and it compresses before equalizing on the AlbumDB bass and drum subgroups (Figure 6 ). Every GRAFX chain keeps the console order of EQ, distortion, compressor, noise gate, stereo imager, gain/panning, delay, and reverb, so its gate always follows the compressor.
paragraphs.zh: MixAgent 为每个元素选择顺序。 它在鼓组（图 5）和人声（图 7 和图 8）上把噪声门放在压缩器之前，这与工程师通常的做法一致；并且在 AlbumDB 的贝斯和鼓子分组上先压缩后均衡（图 6）。 每条 GRAFX 链都保持控制台上均衡器、失真、压缩器、噪声门、立体声成像器、增益/声像、延迟和混响的顺序，因此其噪声门始终位于压缩器之后。

sents.en: MixAgent chooses the order for each element.
sents.zh: MixAgent 为每个元素选择顺序。

sents.en: It places the noise gate before the compressor on the drums (Figure 5 ) and on the vocals (Figures 7 and 8 ), as engineers usually do, and it compresses before equalizing on the AlbumDB bass and drum subgroups (Figure 6 ).
sents.zh: 它在鼓组（图 5）和人声（图 7 和图 8）上把噪声门放在压缩器之前，这与工程师通常的做法一致；并且在 AlbumDB 的贝斯和鼓子分组上先压缩后均衡（图 6）。

sents.en: Every GRAFX chain keeps the console order of EQ, distortion, compressor, noise gate, stereo imager, gain/panning, delay, and reverb, so its gate always follows the compressor.
sents.zh: 每条 GRAFX 链都保持控制台上均衡器、失真、压缩器、噪声门、立体声成像器、增益/声像、延迟和混响的顺序，因此其噪声门始终位于压缩器之后。

paragraphs.en: MixAgent uses two to five audio effects per track, adds no delay or reverb to bass tracks, and often applies reverb once on a subgroup rather than on each track, as on the drum and piano subgroups in Figure 5 . Its full-mix chain varies across clips and includes a multiband compressor in Figure 5 . GRAFX keeps one to seven audio effects per track and adds delay or reverb to most tracks, including the bass tracks in Figures 5 and 6 . Its full-mix chain always contains EQ, distortion, a stereo imager, and gain/panning, and three of the four add a limiter.
paragraphs.zh: MixAgent 在每条音轨上使用两到五个音频效果器，不给贝斯音轨添加延迟或混响，并且通常在子组上应用一次混响而不是在每条音轨上分别应用，如图 5 中的鼓和钢琴子组。 它的整体混音链在不同片段间有所不同，并在图 5 中包含一个多段压缩器。 GRAFX 在每条音轨上保留一到七个音频效果器，并给大多数音轨添加延迟或混响，包括图 5 和图 6 中的贝斯音轨。 它的整体混音链始终包含均衡器、失真、立体声成像器和增益/声像，并且四个片段中有三个还添加了限制器。

paragraphs.en: All rows use the same learned detector. The untrained rows prompt Qwen3-Omni as the critic. The trained critic is a different model (Table 7 ), and DPO starts from its SFT checkpoint.
